title: Linked Barcode for Persistence Induced by Filtrations
summary: The well-known persistence algorithm summarizes the evolution of homological cycles into what is called a \emph{barcode} while scanning an input simplicial filtration. We show that this summarization process can be enriched by monitoring other algebraic structures that weave through different dimensions. In particular, we propose an algorithm to monitor the $(p+1)$-chains that make $p$-cycles to be $p$-boundaries and then morph into $(p+1)$-cycles.
